title: Critical and near-critical influence bounds for ferromagnetic Ising models
summary: For a ferromagnetic Ising model on a graph of maximum degree $Δ\ge3$, we prove a bound of order $\sqrt n$ on every row of the influence matrix at the tree uniqueness threshold. The estimate is uniform in the degree, the external fields, and all pinnings. More generally, if the couplings are bounded by $β$ and $\varepsilon=((Δ-1)\tanhβ-1)_+$, the bound is $C(\sqrt n+n\varepsilon)$. The proof combines a pointwise cavity bound with a positive-series magnetization tilt and the field comparison theorem of Ding, Song and Sun.
